title: Recommendations of Shaving Head and Taqseer
categoryChain: Recommendations of Shaving Head and Taqseer
introduction:
RECOMMENDATIONS OF SHAVING HEAD AND TAQSEER

It is recommended to sit facing Qiblah, taking the name of Allah. One should start from the right of front part and say:

It is better to recite this also:

It is recommended to bury one's hair in one's tent at Mina. It is recommended to trim one's beard, moustache and nails after shaving the head.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِنِیْ بِكُلِّ شَعْرَۃٍ نُوْرًا یَوْمَ الْقِیَامَۃِ۔
وَ حَسَنَاتٍ مُضَاعَفَاتٍ وَ كَفِّرْ عَنِّیْ السَّیِّئَاتِ اِنَّكَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَیْئٍ قَدِیْرٌ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔
